summary: But isn't about #cs4all. About a fundamental shift in literacy practices, new socio-technical systems that may require a rethinking of philosophies of knowledge. Not a problem of code but of meaning. To me, give a kid a domain, let them play. Save society.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
But isn't about #cs4all. About a fundamental shift in literacy practices, new socio-technical systems that may require a rethinking of philosophies of knowledge. Not a problem of code but of meaning.

To me, give a kid a domain, let them play. Save society.
